posts.title: New Nordic Home
body: This summer, after months of planning, a long held dream of ours came true. We have always wanted to expand our business beyond jewelry, but there never seemed to be enough time to work on something entirely new. Well as anyone familiar with entrepreneur life knows, sometimes things just have to get done. After long nights followed by very busy days, we’re proud to finally be able to reveal our first foray into home décor.

Our gorgeous Nordic wool blankets are woven from pure New Zealand wool with our unique Icelandic design. The exceptional quality of these blankets reflects all the best characteristics of wool produced in the Nordic regions – warmth, durability, breathability, and water-repellency.

The striking Nordic Love and Nordic Strength patterns are designed using our own bindrune symbols as individual graphic units. We continue to transform the runes by layering and arranging the symbols, thus uniting the mystical qualities of Norse tradition and inspirational modern talismans. Each luxurious blanket is imbued with a message meant to inspire and empower you every day.
We are looking forward to the next beautiful additions to our line of home textiles, so stay tuned!

posts.title: A Fresh Start
body: Each new day offers up a wealth of new opportunities; the chance to accept another challenge, jump-start your dreams, re-route plans that might have taken a wrong turn. For us as a small family company, it is sometimes tricky to discern between personal and professional goals, which tend to become entwined. And actually, that’s ok!

One thing that makes Alrún special is our personal investment in the company. Our CEO and head designer Jón Bjarni dreamed up the idea for Alrún almost twenty years ago, and ever since, it has been his passion to create beautiful pieces that connect with all the colourful, multifaceted, interesting people we meet.
Sometimes however, we have to refresh our outlook, re-start the creative process, or reconnect with old ideas. Occasionally we’ve just got to shelve something that isn’t working.

So, what do you need in your life to make a fresh start? Your goals and dreams are deeply personal, but can make a very public impact. An Alrún bindrune can be the symbol of an important turning point in your life, and the inspiration you carry with you everyday. Wishing you Love, Strength, Luck, and more, as you jump into the next phase of your journey!

posts.title: Studs Are In!
body: Our newest earrings have arrived, and they are tiny! We like to think of them as “small but mighty”, because despite their delicate size, each represents an idea powerful enough to inspire you every day.

Our charming .925 silver studs are 11mm in length, while our sparkling silver and crystal studs feature hand-set white zirconia, and are 16mm long. Both ranges are available in Love, Luck, Heart, Strength, Energy, and Music symbols.

If you love to make a statement in a subtle way, these earrings will make the perfect addition to your jewelry collection. Pair your Alrún studs with a matching pendant, or mix and match your favourite symbols to send a multifaceted message. Share what makes you unique!

posts.title: Famous Faces
body: When Harper’s Bazaar gets in touch, you pay attention! Marketing is a minefield, especially for a small company with an unusual design aesthetic, but the opportunity to see our jewelry in the pages of Harper’s was an offer we couldn’t refuse. That initial contact has led to numerous new possibilities that we hadn’t anticipated. An investment that yields continuous, unexpected benefits – how great is that?

The North American cover of the September issue featured the ubiquitous Kim & Kanye – can they move copy or what? In Europe, the ravishing Rosie Huntington-Whitely graced the front page with aplomb. We are extremely pleased with our ad, and even more so with the response it has inspired. Much more to come!

posts.title: Image and Identity
body: We were lucky enough to work with a few of Iceland’s most talented fashion professionals on our latest photo series, and they have certainly inspired us to continue expanding our creative perspective. Our shoot focussed on the interaction between ancient and contemporary design, and we wanted to explore this idea alongside the interconnectedness of natural and urban areas in our images. We visited the outdoor art installation Þúfa by Ólöf Nordal, as well as a gorgeous hilltop park devoted to the modern sculptures of Hallstein Sigurðsson, whom we’d like to thank for giving us permission to photograph his work.

One of the wonderful aspects of Reykjavík is its proximity to nature – the way that people can merge with the mountains or the sea, or escape to rural places only minutes from the city’s edge. Our beautiful model Thelma definitely felt nature’s presence, spending hours modelling outside in a bitterly cold wind. Icelandic weather always makes an impact, no matter what time of year it is! Our thanks to the team for their expertise and insight – we can’t wait for our next project.

Photography: Íris Stefánsdóttir, styling: Friðrik Agni Árnason, hair & makeup: Fríða María Harðardóttir, model: Thelma Hrönn Sigurdórsdóttir, fashion: Steini Design, Svava Magdalena, and model’s own wardrobe.

posts.title: Alrún’s Energy at the Iceland Winter Games
body: Entering for third year, the Iceland Winter Games took part once again from March 24th to April 3rd 2016.We are excited to see the momentum this event has generated, and it is a special thrill to see Alrún’s Energy symbol on athletic apparel and in various other forms, like the great winter hat pictured! In cooperation with the Iceland Winter Games, we allowed the adaptation of our Energy bindrune into the IWG logo to reflect the importance of nature and landscape in outdoor winter sports. As more and more people are discovering, there is an incredible natural energy in the Icelandic landscape – it resonates with the elite athletes who feel this same fire within themselves.

Alrún is proud to support the athletes of the Iceland Winter Games, and we wish all participants a fantastic experience at this year’s competition. Love winter sports? Love Iceland? Find out more about the IWG here: http://www.icelandwintergames.com/

posts.title: Old Ship, New Look
body: Alrún’s core designs are a set of twelve bindrune symbols that we produce in .925 sterling silver, and now in .925 sterling silver with cubic zirconia crystals. Our interests have always been deeply rooted in Nordic history, so it was important that when designing the display for our bindrunes, we kept these ancient connections alive. Oslo’s Viking Ship Museum is home to the Oseberg Viking ship, an almost perfectly reconstructed Viking vessel famous for its intricate ornamentation. The beautiful spiral at the end of the bow post is an iconic image, and it is this aspect of the Oseberg ship that inspired our pendant display. It’s a bit of a new look for an old ship that remains an important part of Alrún Nordic Jewelry. To learn more about the Oseberg Viking Ship, visit:http://www.khm.uio.no/english/visit-us/viking-ship-museum/exhibitions/oseberg/

posts.title: New Beginnings
body: Welcome! At Alrún Nordic Jewelry, we like to stay pretty low key. That’s why for years, we have successfully run our business in a low-tech kind of way, preferring to focus on forging strong personal connections with our clients and creating beautiful pieces of jewelry that speak to the heart. It’s time, however, for our tiny company to grow! We bring with us nearly 17 years of hands-on experience in the jewelry business, and we are proud of our inclusive, distinctive bindrune designs. As we sail into new waters, we hope you will enjoy getting to know our brand – we look forward to hearing from you.
